churches.assessment: Grace Presbyterian Church is a confessional Presbyterian Church in America (PCA) congregation in Aiken, South Carolina, holding the Westminster Confession and Catechisms as “our only rule for faith and life.” It keeps the traditional Reformed rhythm — morning and evening worship, Wednesday men’s and women’s Bible studies, and a monthly Lord’s Supper — and is led by a plurality of male elders under Palmetto Presbytery. An acquaintance of MOOP whose family attends describes the pastor as excellent and the culture as explicitly patriarchal and family-integrated, with head coverings common among the women and a large contingent of young families; the fellowship meals are a highlight and the main critique is simply a lengthy service. It earns green across all ten categories. (Identification note: an acquaintance of MOOP recommended “Grace Presbyterian (PCA)” without a city; this Aiken congregation is the strong match by denomination and proximity to the Springfield, SC daughter-church plant they described — confirm if a direct link is available.)
